text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe has been printing money but instead of passing on the profits made, has built luxury chalets and showered some of its senior staff with perks described by economists as "outrageous".
- Zimbabwe's health authorities have been asked to carry out AIDS tests on all rape victims so that the cases can be referred to the High Court if the victims are infected.
